Hi Vivek / Monica,

We started the supplier registration flow in Ariba this morning to receive POs from Redwood but we keep hitting an error at the final step: the portal returns "ORG_CLAIM_MISMATCH" and won't let us submit the onboarding form. The error message reads: "Organization identifier does not match DUNS/tax ID on file. Contact buyer to reconcile."

Attached are the completed onboarding form and our W9. We also included a quick screenshot of the portal error (portal_error_screenshot.png). Can you advise what Redwood expects for the organization claim? Our legal name is MerlinCloud Inc., tax EIN 12-3456789, DUNS 11-222-3333.

We're blocked from receiving our initial PO for the pilot. Could someone from procurement ops help reconcile the account claim so we can finish sign-up?

Thanks,

Hi Priyanka — thanks for the details and attachments. Sorry you're blocked. Quick answers and next steps: 

- The "organization claim" is our procurement system mapping to the buyer-side company record (legal name + address + tax id). If any field differs (e.g., DBA vs legal name or EIN formatting) Ariba flags the mismatch.
- Monica (cc) is our procurement ops lead; she'll confirm what we have on file and open an Ariba support ticket if needed.

Action items:
1) Monica to validate our buyer record for MerlinCloud and confirm what value Ariba expects.
2) If it's on our side, we'll push the fix and tell you to retry. If it's on Ariba's side, we'll escalate to Ariba Support.
3) Ben — can you check if there are any PO routing rules that would prevent MerlinCloud from receiving the pilot PO until the claim is reconciled?

Priyanka — one quick thing: can you confirm the exact legal address you used in the form (street, city, state, zip)? Sometimes the portal expects match down to the street formatting.

I'll keep this thread alive until resolved.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partner Enablement, Redwood Inference

Hi Priyanka — I pulled our buyer record for MerlinCloud and see two entries in Ariba: one under "MerlinCloud, LLC" (older) and one under "MerlinCloud Inc." (newer). The portal appears to be matching to the older record which has a different address on file (123 Harbor Blvd). That explains the ORG_CLAIM_MISMATCH.

Plan:
- I've opened AribaTicket#A-987654 with Ariba Support requesting they collapse duplicates and align the active buyer mapping to "MerlinCloud Inc., 1207 Harbor Drive".
- Ben: please hold any PO routing rules for MerlinCloud to prevent a stale record from blocking test POs (we'll route manually if needed).
- Priyanka: if Ariba needs proof of address or an alternate legal doc, please reply with a copy of the certificate of incorporation or a recent utility bill. W9 is on file but Ariba sometimes requests an address corroboration doc.

I'll update when Ariba responds (they quoted 48–72 hours). In the meantime, Vivek and I can schedule a quick screenshare Monday to verify the registration flow.

Thanks,
